name: Fortune Cookie
summary: A coupon field where a valid code cracks a fortune cookie open and its paper slip is your discount
about: An order summary with a coupon field and a fortune cookie on a lacquer plate. Applying a good code makes the cookie wobble, crack and spring apart in a shower of crumbs while a paper fortune unrolls with the offer, then drops into the summary as a discount row while the total rolls down. A wrong code makes the cookie shake its head, and removing the coupon snaps the halves back together.
how: Type a code or tap CHAI10, FREESHIP or BIG500, then press Apply or Enter
The button squashes and the cookie wobbles harder and harder while the code is checked
A good code cracks the cookie: the halves spring apart, crumbs bounce on the plate and the fortune unrolls
The fortune drops into the summary, a discount row opens, the old total is struck out and the new one rolls down
A wrong code shakes the cookie and the field; BIG500 nearly cracks it and says how much more to add; × removes the coupon
